title: Tab takes the dim completion after the caret
steps: Press / and type fro, then press Tab
Type the first two letters of a person's name after from: and look at the field
Type su, press Escape once to close the suggestions, then press Tab
expected: After fro the field shows a dim m: after the caret and Tab turns it into from:. After from: and two letters the field shows the rest of the person's name in dim text, a ⇥ and the address it will use; Tab puts the address in and it becomes a pill. With the suggestions closed, the dim completion is still shown and Tab still completes su into subject:. The caret stays in the field each time.
